story_text: As a guest, I want the system to reject more than 10 guests per booking so that room capacity is respected.

positive.title: Booking with exactly 10 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '10'
4. Click submit

positive.title: Booking with exactly 1 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '1'
4. Click submit

negative.title: Booking with exactly 11 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '11'
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: Booking error and user being prompted that the maximum amount are 10 guests

negative.title: Booking with more than 11 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '12+'
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: Booking error and user being prompted that the maximum amount are 10 guests

negative.title: Error message is returned for exceeding capacity
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '11'
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: Booking error and user being prompted that the maximum amount are 10 guests

edge.title: Booking with 0 guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '0'
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: Booking error and user being prompted that the minimum amount is 1 guest

edge.title: Booking with a negative guest count
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with '-1'
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: Booking error and user being prompted that the minimum amount is 1 guest

edge.title: Booking with a non-numeric guest count
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Create a new booking
3. Fill the guest number field with 'names'
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error stating that this field requires number input
